blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur – A 56-year-old public elementary school principal was arrested alongside four alleged street-level pushers during an early morning buy-bust operation in San Jose, Dinagat Islands on Friday. Operatives from the Regional Drug Enforcement Unit-13 (RDEU-13) and the Regional Intelligence Division-13 (RID-13), backed by the San Jose Municipal Police Station and the Dinagat Islands Provincial Mobile Force Platoon, conducted the sting at around 12:45 a.m. in Barangay Don Ruben, said Col. Glenn Sampaga, provincial director of the Dinagat Islands Police Provincial Office. Police identified the primary target as alias “Wel,” 56, an elementary school head and resident […]...
